name: Mind Flayer
traits: Medium Aberration. +2 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +8 Intelligence, +6 Wisdom, +6 Charisma. Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +3 natural armor.
Four primary tentacle attacks deal 1d4 bludgeoning each before Strength.

Mind Blast (Sp) affects creatures in a 60-ft. cone. A failed Will save stuns for 3d4 rounds. The Charisma-based DC is 14 + Charisma modifier, reflecting a 4th-level equivalent. The entry gives no use limit.
Psionics (Sp), CL 8. At will, charm monster, detect thoughts, levitate, plane shift, and suggestion. Save DCs use Charisma.

Improved Grab (Ex). A tentacle hit on a Small, Medium, or Large creature allows a free grapple attempt without provoking. On success the tentacle attaches to the head. It can grab a Huge or larger creature if it can reach the head.

If one or more tentacles are attached at the start of the mind flayer’s turn, one grapple check can attach the rest. The target can escape all with one successful opposed grapple or Escape Artist check. The mind flayer gets +2 on the opposed check per tentacle attached at the start of the opponent’s turn.

Extract (Ex). Start the turn with all four tentacles attached and win a grapple check to extract the brain. This is normally fatal. The printed rule exempts constructs, elementals, oozes, plants, and undead, and extraction does not instantly kill a creature with multiple heads.
Telepathy (Su) communicates with a creature within 100 ft. that has a language. The two creatures can use different languages.

Eight racial Hit Dice (8d8) grant BAB +6, base Fortitude +2, Reflex +2, Will +6, and three feats. Racial skill points are 11 × (2 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Bluff, Concentration, Hide, Intimidate, Knowledge (any), Listen, Move Silently, and Spot.
Common and Undercommon are automatic. Bonus languages are Abyssal, Aquan, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Infernal, and Terran.
LA +7. ECL 15 before class levels and ECL 16 with one class level. Favored class Wizard.
Uses the Monster Manual’s innate spell-like abilities. The Expanded Psionics Handbook presents a separate power-point variant.
